spec.candidate_selection: Frozen source snapshots. Screen retains all passing distinct remote branch roots for development. Final takes the leading four development means plus the incumbent; no strategic coefficients fitted.
spec.inference: Only final aggregate paired intervals are confirmatory. Each final map crosses all seats/tokens and all three fields. Promotion needs zero contract/worker faults, a positive paired map-clustered interval against the incumbent, and inspection of novel-only and per-field results. Otherwise retain the incumbent and report uncertainty.
spec.challenger_scope: Per-map generated opponents are reset for every game and identical across candidate pairs. Each stage reserves different decision rules. Parameters are drawn without checking how they perform against any focal candidate.

note: Exception tracing is sampled only in diagnostic mode; its timings are not competition timings. State fingerprints are outside measured callback time. Matched strength games use actual 200ms / 2s limits.
